paragraphs.source_en: If they were to engage the enemy on open ground, this was the only suitable place. Mizuno Katsushige ordered Komatsuyama occupied so that the enemy's movements could be watched, then commanded Okuda San'emon and Matsukura Bungo-no-kami to advance first.

units.source_en: If they were to engage the enemy on open ground, this was the only suitable place.

ja.t: うなら、ここをおいてほかに

units.source_zh: 若是在平原上与敌人相搏，只有此处为宜。

units.source_en: Mizuno Katsushige ordered Komatsuyama occupied so that the enemy's movements could be watched, then commanded Okuda San'emon and Matsukura Bungo-no-kami to advance first.
units.source_zh: 水野胜成下令，占领小松山，以监视敌人的行动，后令奥田三右卫门和松仓丰后守先行出兵。

paragraphs.source_zh: 若是在平原上与敌人相搏，只有此处为宜。水野胜成下令，占领小松山，以监视敌人的行动，后令奥田三右卫门和松仓丰后守先行出兵。

paragraphs.source_en: Once the battlefield had been chosen, the heights of Komatsuyama naturally became the vital ground for which both sides contended.

units.source_en: Once the battlefield had been chosen, the heights of Komatsuyama naturally became the vital ground for which both sides contended.
units.source_zh: 确定战场之后，小松山的高地自然成了双方争夺的紧要处。

paragraphs.source_zh: 确定战场之后，小松山的高地自然成了双方争夺的紧要处。

paragraphs.source_en: Okuda San'emon swiftly advanced toward Komatsuyama. But he was slain by Gotō Matabei Mototsugu, who had reached and occupied Komatsuyama before him.

units.source_en: Okuda San'emon swiftly advanced toward Komatsuyama.
units.source_zh: 奥田三右卫门迅速朝小松山进发。

units.source_en: But he was slain by Gotō Matabei Mototsugu, who had reached and occupied Komatsuyama before him.
units.source_zh: 但是，他却死在先他一步占了小松山的后藤又兵卫基次枪下。

paragraphs.source_zh: 奥田三右卫门迅速朝小松山进发。但是，他却死在先他一步占了小松山的后藤又兵卫基次枪下。

paragraphs.source_en: The opening clash had gone badly, and now battle cries erupted from the summit.

units.source_en: The opening clash had gone badly, and now battle cries erupted from the summit.
units.source_zh: 初战不利，此时又听得山顶呐喊四起。

paragraphs.source_zh: 初战不利，此时又听得山顶呐喊四起。

paragraphs.source_en: “Damn! The enemy has taken the summit! Whose banner is that?”

units.source_en: “Damn!
The enemy has taken the summit!
units.source_zh: 敌人已占领山顶！

units.source_en: Whose banner is that?”
units.source_zh: 那是何人的旗帜？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “糟！敌人已占领山顶！那是何人的旗帜？”

paragraphs.source_en: When Matsukura Bungo-no-kami Shigemasa, lord of Gojō in Yamato, learned that the man on the summit was Gotō Matabei, he immediately deployed his firearms to the north and prepared to attack.

units.source_en: When Matsukura Bungo-no-kami Shigemasa, lord of Gojō in Yamato, learned that the man on the summit was Gotō Matabei, he immediately deployed his firearms to the north and prepared to attack.
units.source_zh: 大和五条的领主松仓丰后守重正得知山顶上乃是后藤又兵卫，立时在北面布好了枪支，准备发起进攻。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大和五条的领主松仓丰后守重正得知山顶上乃是后藤又兵卫，立时在北面布好了枪支，准备发起进攻。

paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, Matsukura was not the only commander of the Eastern Army preparing to attack. “I cannot fall behind and become a laughingstock!” With Tōdō Takahisa in front and Amano Yoshihisa behind, each led a small detachment around to the northwestern side of the mountain and stormed upward.

units.source_en: At that moment, Matsukura was not the only commander of the Eastern Army preparing to attack.
units.source_zh: 此时，准备发动进攻的东军并不只是松仓一人。

units.source_en: “I cannot fall behind and become a laughingstock!”

ja.t: になるわけにはいかぬ！」

units.source_zh: “我可不能落了后，让人笑话！”

units.source_en: With Tōdō Takahisa in front and Amano Yoshihisa behind, each led a small detachment around to the northwestern side of the mountain and stormed upward.
units.source_zh: 藤堂高久在前，天野可古在后，各率领小队人马转到山的西北侧，往上强攻。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，准备发动进攻的东军并不只是松仓一人。“我可不能落了后，让人笑话！”藤堂高久在前，天野可古在后，各率领小队人马转到山的西北侧，往上强攻。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, every report of a firearm brought down another man from Gotō's force. And the more rapid the gunfire became, the more men fell.

units.source_en: Before long, every report of a firearm brought down another man from Gotō's force.
units.source_zh: 未几，每次枪声响起，后藤部都会有人倒下。

units.source_en: And the more rapid the gunfire became, the more men fell.
units.source_zh: 而且，枪声愈紧，倒下的人愈多。

paragraphs.source_zh: 未几，每次枪声响起，后藤部都会有人倒下。而且，枪声愈紧，倒下的人愈多。

paragraphs.source_en: On Komatsuyama, Mototsugu was caught in a three-sided assault by Mizuno, Date, and the spirited young Matsudaira Tadaaki; he could hold out no longer.

units.source_en: On Komatsuyama, Mototsugu was caught in a three-sided assault by Mizuno, Date, and the spirited young Matsudaira Tadaaki; he could hold out no longer.

ja.t: ちこたえられなくなっていた。

units.source_zh: 小松山上，基次遭受着水野、伊达及年轻气盛的松平忠明三方夹击，他已无法硬撑下去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 小松山上，基次遭受着水野、伊达及年轻气盛的松平忠明三方夹击，他已无法硬撑下去。

paragraphs.source_en: Mōri Katsunaga, Akashi Morishige, Sanada Yukimura, and the others had set out from Tennōji and were hurrying this way, but they must have encountered other enemy forces advancing through the Kawachi approach. Mototsugu decided that it would be best to abandon Komatsuyama and withdraw to Dōmyōji, thereby drawing off at least some of the Eastern Army's pressure on his allies.

units.source_en: Mōri Katsunaga, Akashi Morishige, Sanada Yukimura, and the others had set out from Tennōji and were hurrying this way, but they must have encountered other enemy forces advancing through the Kawachi approach.
units.source_zh: 毛利胜永、明石守重和真田幸村等人从天王寺出发，正朝这边赶来，途中一定遭遇了沿河内口而来的其他敌军。

units.source_en: Mototsugu decided that it would be best to abandon Komatsuyama and withdraw to Dōmyōji, thereby drawing off at least some of the Eastern Army's pressure on his allies.
units.source_zh: 基次认为，自己最好放弃这小松山，撤至道明寺，这样或多或少能为友军分散些东军的压力。

paragraphs.source_zh: 毛利胜永、明石守重和真田幸村等人从天王寺出发，正朝这边赶来，途中一定遭遇了沿河内口而来的其他敌军。基次认为，自己最好放弃这小松山，撤至道明寺，这样或多或少能为友军分散些东军的压力。

paragraphs.source_en: “Will you all die alongside Mototsugu?”

units.source_en: “Will you all die alongside Mototsugu?”
units.source_zh: “弟兄们要和基次一起赴死吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “弟兄们要和基次一起赴死吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: The soldiers answered as one, raising their weapons high.

units.source_en: The soldiers answered as one, raising their weapons high.
units.source_zh: 士兵们应声回答，同时高高举起武刀。

paragraphs.source_zh: 士兵们应声回答，同时高高举起武刀。

paragraphs.source_en: Matabei's face twisted with emotion as he cried, “Good! Then Gotō Mototsugu will stand on no ceremony with you, my brothers. Divide into two columns and strike the enemy head-on!”

units.source_en: Matabei's face twisted with emotion as he cried, “Good! Then Gotō Mototsugu will stand on no ceremony with you, my brothers.
units.source_zh: 又兵卫的脸因感动而扭曲，他大声道：“好，后藤基次也就不跟兄弟们客气了。

units.source_en: Divide into two columns and strike the enemy head-on!”
units.source_zh: 兵分两路，直击敌人！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 又兵卫的脸因感动而扭曲，他大声道：“好，后藤基次也就不跟兄弟们客气了。兵分两路，直击敌人！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, sir!”

units.source_en: “Yes, sir!”

paragraphs.source_en: “Good! Charge!” Gotō Matabei gave a battle cry, his heart filled at once with exhilaration and melancholy: what, in the end, did death mean?

units.source_en: “Good!
Charge!”
units.source_zh: 杀啊！”

units.source_en: Gotō Matabei gave a battle cry, his heart filled at once with exhilaration and melancholy: what, in the end, did death mean?
units.source_zh: 后藤又兵卫一声呐喊，心中又是快慰，又是感慨：死亡的意味究竟为何？

paragraphs.source_zh: “好！杀啊！”后藤又兵卫一声呐喊，心中又是快慰，又是感慨：死亡的意味究竟为何？

paragraphs.source_en: A thousand emotions surging within him, Mototsugu charged with all his might into the pursuing Mizuno troops. The enemy ranks instantly opened before him, and two or three detachments visibly fell into disorder.

units.source_en: A thousand emotions surging within him, Mototsugu charged with all his might into the pursuing Mizuno troops.
units.source_zh: 基次生出万般感喟，奋力冲进了尾随追来的水野军中。

units.source_en: The enemy ranks instantly opened before him, and two or three detachments visibly fell into disorder.
units.source_zh: 敌军顿时闪开一条道，两三个小队眼见着乱了阵脚。

paragraphs.source_zh: 基次生出万般感喟，奋力冲进了尾随追来的水野军中。敌军顿时闪开一条道，两三个小队眼见着乱了阵脚。

paragraphs.source_en: “Brothers, charge!”

units.source_en: “Brothers, charge!”
units.source_zh: “弟兄们，杀啊！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “弟兄们，杀啊！”

paragraphs.source_en: Gotō Matabei's valor on this occasion was later recorded in the Akutagawa Documents as follows: “...In martial prowess, none since the days of the Genji and Heike can have equaled him; truly, it was a deed without precedent.”

units.source_en: Gotō Matabei's valor on this occasion was later recorded in the Akutagawa Documents as follows: “...In martial prowess, none since the days of the Genji and Heike can have equaled him; truly, it was a deed without precedent.”

ja.t: なしというべく、まことに

units.source_zh: 此时后藤又兵卫的英勇之举，后人《芥田文书》中记述如下：“……其武勇，自源平以来应无人可比，诚为前所未闻之举。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时后藤又兵卫的英勇之举，后人《芥田文书》中记述如下：“……其武勇，自源平以来应无人可比，诚为前所未闻之举。”

paragraphs.source_en: Having performed a feat of courage unlike anything his contemporaries had ever seen, Mototsugu's mind must have been utterly free of distraction.

units.source_en: Having performed a feat of courage unlike anything his contemporaries had ever seen, Mototsugu's mind must have been utterly free of distraction.
units.source_zh: 既做出时人未见过的勇猛之举，基次定是心无杂念。

paragraphs.source_zh: 既做出时人未见过的勇猛之举，基次定是心无杂念。

paragraphs.source_en: Seeing Mototsugu throw Mizuno's ranks into confusion, Niwa's troops immediately unleashed fierce fire from the flank. The coordination among the Eastern Army's various contingents was truly flawless.

units.source_en: Seeing Mototsugu throw Mizuno's ranks into confusion, Niwa's troops immediately unleashed fierce fire from the flank.
units.source_zh: 见基次令水野军阵脚大乱，丹羽部立时从侧面猛烈射击。

units.source_en: The coordination among the Eastern Army's various contingents was truly flawless.
units.source_zh: 东军各部之间的配合真可谓天衣无缝。

paragraphs.source_zh: 见基次令水野军阵脚大乱，丹羽部立时从侧面猛烈射击。东军各部之间的配合真可谓天衣无缝。

paragraphs.source_en: It was already noon.

units.source_en: It was already noon.
units.source_zh: 时已正午。

paragraphs.source_zh: 时已正午。

paragraphs.source_en: The sun beat mercilessly down on everyone; men on both sides were covered in dust, sweat streaming over their faces, every one of them exhausted.

units.source_en: The sun beat mercilessly down on everyone; men on both sides were covered in dust, sweat streaming over their faces, every one of them exhausted.
units.source_zh: 太阳火辣辣晒着每一个人，对阵双方无不浑身尘土，汗流满面，个个疲惫不堪。

paragraphs.source_zh: 太阳火辣辣晒着每一个人，对阵双方无不浑身尘土，汗流满面，个个疲惫不堪。

paragraphs.source_en: Struck by Niwa's attack, Gotō's troops immediately fell into disorder and threw themselves prone in a wheat field beside the road. When they rose from the wheat field, well over half their number was gone. Some had fled amid the confusion, but most had been shot dead by firearms, and corpses lay heaped across the ground.

units.source_en: Struck by Niwa's attack, Gotō's troops immediately fell into disorder and threw themselves prone in a wheat field beside the road.
units.source_zh: 遭到丹羽部袭击，后藤军立时乱了阵脚，皆匍匐于路旁麦田里。

units.source_en: When they rose from the wheat field, well over half their number was gone. Some had fled amid the confusion, but most had been shot dead by firearms, and corpses lay heaped across the ground.

ja.t: がったときには、すでに

units.source_zh: 当他们从麦田里站起身来，人已少了大半，也有趁乱逃窜的，但大部为火枪打死，地上尸首累累。

paragraphs.source_zh: 遭到丹羽部袭击，后藤军立时乱了阵脚，皆匍匐于路旁麦田里。当他们从麦田里站起身来，人已少了大半，也有趁乱逃窜的，但大部为火枪打死，地上尸首累累。

paragraphs.source_en: When the enemy ceased firing, Mototsugu leapt back onto his horse. But by then, everyone except him had been wounded and could no longer mount; he had become, in the truest sense, a lone horseman. Beside him, the two commanders Yamada Geki and Furusawa Mitsuoki already lay dead.

units.source_en: When the enemy ceased firing, Mototsugu leapt back onto his horse.
units.source_zh: 见敌人不再射击，基次跳回马上。

units.source_en: But by then, everyone except him had been wounded and could no longer mount; he had become, in the truest sense, a lone horseman.
units.source_zh: 但此时，除他之外，所有人都已负伤，无法再上马，他成了名副其实的“单骑”。

units.source_en: Beside him, the two commanders Yamada Geki and Furusawa Mitsuoki already lay dead.
units.source_zh: 他旁边，山田外记和古泽满兴二将领已横尸于地。

paragraphs.source_zh: 见敌人不再射击，基次跳回马上。但此时，除他之外，所有人都已负伤，无法再上马，他成了名副其实的“单骑”。他旁边，山田外记和古泽满兴二将领已横尸于地。

paragraphs.source_en: “To the riverbank!” Mototsugu said. The command sprang from his will to survive. Rather than hold out here under repeated enemy fire, it would be better to plunge into the water and wade to the opposite bank. Once across the Dōmyōji River, he would naturally be somewhat closer to his allies.

units.source_en: “To the riverbank!”
units.source_zh: “去川边！”

units.source_en: Mototsugu said.
units.source_zh: 基次道。

units.source_en: The command sprang from his will to survive.
units.source_zh: 他这是基于求生之念。

units.source_en: Rather than hold out here under repeated enemy fire, it would be better to plunge into the water and wade to the opposite bank.
units.source_zh: 与其在这里硬撑着遭受敌军的反复射击，还不如跳进水里，蹚到对岸。

units.source_en: Once across the Dōmyōji River, he would naturally be somewhat closer to his allies.
units.source_zh: 涉水过了道明寺川，自与友军接近几分。

paragraphs.source_zh: “去川边！”基次道。他这是基于求生之念。与其在这里硬撑着遭受敌军的反复射击，还不如跳进水里，蹚到对岸。涉水过了道明寺川，自与友军接近几分。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah... ah!” Mototsugu groaned several times, and his massive body toppled from the saddle into the field.

units.source_en: “Ah... ah!”
Mototsugu groaned several times, and his massive body toppled from the saddle into the field.
units.source_zh: 基次呻吟几声，庞大的身躯翻落马下，掉进田里。

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊，啊！”基次呻吟几声，庞大的身躯翻落马下，掉进田里。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord! Please, hold on!” His attendant Kanagata Heizōemon hurried over to support him, only to find the fallen Mototsugu staring blankly at the sky with wide, lifeless eyes.

units.source_en: “My lord!
units.source_zh: “大人！

units.source_en: Please, hold on!”
units.source_zh: 请振作些！”

units.source_en: His attendant Kanagata Heizōemon hurried over to support him, only to find the fallen Mototsugu staring blankly at the sky with wide, lifeless eyes.
units.source_zh: 侍卫金方平左卫门慌忙过来扶持，却见落马的基次瞪着一双无神的大眼，茫然望着天空。

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人！请振作些！”侍卫金方平左卫门慌忙过来扶持，却见落马的基次瞪着一双无神的大眼，茫然望着天空。

paragraphs.source_en: “I understand, my lord!” Tears in his eyes, Kanagata Heizōemon drew his great sword.

units.source_en: “I understand, my lord!”
units.source_zh: “小的明白！”

units.source_en: Tears in his eyes, Kanagata Heizōemon drew his great sword.
units.source_zh: 金方平左卫门眼中含泪，拔出了大刀。

paragraphs.source_zh: “小的明白！”金方平左卫门眼中含泪，拔出了大刀。

paragraphs.source_en: He cut off Mototsugu's head and buried it in a nearby field, then quietly crossed the river and escaped.

units.source_en: He cut off Mototsugu's head and buried it in a nearby field, then quietly crossed the river and escaped.
units.source_zh: 他砍下基次的首级，埋在附近的田中，然后悄悄渡河，逃了开去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 他砍下基次的首级，埋在附近的田中，然后悄悄渡河，逃了开去。
